description: This source file defines the 'IniFileModel' class responsible for reading and parsing a configuration INI file ('rusefi.ini') into in-memory models, including dialogs and fields. It includes methods for file reading, parsing lines, handling dialog and field definitions, and storing the parsed information. The class follows a singleton pattern and provides access to parsed dialogs.

classes.name: IniFileModel
classes.description: Main class responsible for loading and parsing the INI configuration file, managing dialogs and fields, and providing access to the parsed data.

classes.name: IniFileModel.State
classes.description: Enum representing the parsing state (SKIPPING or DIALOG).

classes.name: DialogModel
classes.description: Referenced class representing dialog data, with an inner class 'Field' for dialog fields.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main method for testing or command-line execution, printing dialogs.

methods.name: readIniFile
methods.description: Reads and parses the INI file, constructing dialogs.

methods.name: finishDialog
methods.description: Finalizes the current dialog, adding it to the dialogs map.

methods.name: handleLine
methods.description: Processes a line from the INI file, delegating to handleDialog or handleField.

methods.name: handleField
methods.description: Handles a 'field' line, adding a field to the current dialog.

methods.name: handleDialog
methods.description: Handles a 'dialog' line, setting up dialog identifiers.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Removes empty strings from the start of a list.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides singleton access to the IniFileModel instance.

methods.name: getDialogs
methods.description: Returns the map of dialogs parsed from the INI file.
